tdot_hsam_v2.title: Highway System Access Manual, Volume 2: Intersection & Interchange Evaluation

hsm.title: Highway Safety Manual
hsm.decided: critical rate against the corridor's own sites (user, #34 item 7, docs/03); used in every state until that state's own screening is built

crash_costs.missing: TDOT publishes no crash cost table of its own: HSAM Vol. 2 sends practitioners to the LCCET tool with its 'Fatality, injury, PDO' option (p. 2-74, PDF p. 82) and gives no dollar values

statewide_rates.missing: TDOT's statewide average crash rates for similar intersections come from TDOT's STID on request (HSAM Vol. 2 p. 2-19, PDF p. 27); no published table, and CrashIQ has no Tennessee traffic counts

screening.state_method: TDOT's intersection evaluation compares the crash rate with the statewide average and a critical rate at a 99 percent confidence level (HSAM Vol. 2 p. 2-19, PDF p. 27)

min_years.missing: TDOT's intersection evaluation typically uses the most recent three-year period of crashes (HSAM Vol. 2 p. 2-18, PDF p. 26) but sets no minimum for a corridor study

spf_calibration.missing: no Tennessee SPF calibration loaded (no SPF engine); HSAM Vol. 2 runs HSM predictive methods through TDOT's SPICE tool
